content: Human-labeling session — econ-target-cash-amount-by-deadline:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a cash-target drill with seed-rotated base latitude. You hold a full running pipeline — Construction Yard (fact), Ore Refinery (proc), Power Plant (powr), Allied Barracks (tent), War Factory (weap) and one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) on two near ore patches — at either the NORTH (y=10..14) or SOUTH (y=28..32) latitude, with $600 in the bank. Within about 45 turns, reach $6500 cash and own at least two harvesters.
